name: Horizontal lanes (carrot / potato)
description: Same lane geometry as the wheat layout, planted with carrots or potatoes. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Step to the next path (+Z by 6)
harvest_direction: Along X, both sides of the path
water_notes: One water channel per 6 blocks keeps all farmland hydrated (vanilla rule).
